title: GANs to generate high-fidelity privacy-safe datasets
summary: A research codebase comparing CTGAN, a differentially-private CTGAN variant, and a custom FPGAN synthesizer for generating privacy-preserving synthetic tabular datasets (heart, census, diabetes). It imports the standalone ctgan package and wraps it in custom synthesizer classes to build and benchmark these privacy-oriented GAN variants.
evidence: heart.ipynb:32 'import ctgan' and model_ctgan.py wraps CTGANSynthesizer into custom DPCTGAN/FPGAN classes
needs: unclear if custom models directly subclass ctgan.CTGAN internals or just call its API
